newsitem.title: USA: Earthquake jolts California wilderness area.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts California wilderness area.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 4.1 on the open-ended Richter scale shook a wilderness area north of Los Angeles on Wednesday but there were no immediate reports of damage or injuries.
A spokesman for the California Institute of Technology said the tremor struck at 3:09 p.m. local time (2209 GMT) and was centred about eight miles (12 km) north-northwest of the town of Ojai.
"We felt a real sharp jerk," said Bruce Mandell, a member of the Ojai Fire Department in the town some 60 miles (90 km) northwest of Los Angeles.
"It was more like a sonic boom than an earthquake," he said, comparing it to the noise when the space shuttle flies overhead to land at Edwards Air Force base.
Mandell said windows shook in the firehouse, but they had received no reports of damage and had not responded to any emergency calls.
He said the area of the epicentre was sparsely populated scrubland and forest in the Los Padres Wilderness area.
